titulo_fr: Un échange en ligne : Observer les formes
titulo_es: An online exchange: Vocabulary and shapes
intro: He interprets intention, references and answers in a short written conversation. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: He interprets intention, references and answers in a short written conversation. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Attention: The « y » pronoun can take back a place or activity; « en » can replace a mentioned amount. In this fragment, «y» means «There.».

frases.fr: Nabil : « Oui, j'y suis allé mardi; on y apprend à fabriquer une tasse. »
frases.es: Nabil: «Sí, fui el martes; allí se aprende a fabricar una taza.»
frases.en: Nabil: «Yeah, I went on Tuesday; there you learn to make a cup.»

frases.fr: Camille : « J'en ai entendu parler, mais je n'ai pas encore réservé. »
frases.es: Camille: «He oído hablar de él, pero todavía no he reservado.»
frases.en: Camille: «I've heard of him, but I haven't booked yet.»
